live_handoff.headline: SESSION 135 — IDE-9c FIXED (the handoff's item 1). ROOT (the 'EL discipline / delta repaint' framing was WRONG): raw '\t' bytes flowed document -> tui_grid cell -> terminal; a terminal expands a tab by cursor MOTION without erasing the skipped columns, so grid columns desynchronized from screen columns — stale fragments of previous lines under every tab skip, brace-only lines at different indent depths DOUBLED their braces, and the row overflow wrapped trailing spaces onto the next row. Present since the first paint; invisible until scrolling put old glyphs under the skips (first paint lands on the 2J-cleared screen). The painter already overwrites full rows — with one-glyph-per-cell cells that IS complete coverage, no EL needed. FIX at the projection that owns byte<->column math: tui_model::paint_edit expands tabs to 8-column stops via expand_line = THE byte->display-column map (caret, h-shift, selection, highlight spans ALL convert through it — a selection covering the tab byte highlights the whole expanded run); tui_grid::put belts THE CELL INVARIANT (a cell holds one printable byte occupying exactly one terminal column; control bytes render as a visible '?'); ui_term untouched (the renderer was faithful, the cells were wrong). Bytes >= 0x80 still pass byte-per-cell (UTF-8 multi-column glyphs = the doc-lens display-map seat, named residue). GATE: scripts/tui_scroll_gate.sh in fulltest (beside tui_smoke_gate) — madcide on a REAL pty scrolling a tab-indented file 70 steps, screen reconstructed by scripts/tui_scroll_recon.py's VT100 interpreter (REAL tab-stop semantics: 0x09 moves the cursor preserving skipped cells; escape sequences carried across read chunks; OSC consumed) + negative control. Pre-fix 828 corrupted row observations; post-fix 0. JOE 4.6 oracle: same input, same interpreter, 0 document corruption (traps: joe sets application-cursor mode — drive with ^N/^P not CSI B; joe's transient banner scrolls THROUGH the text area, not corruption). Dupaudit (tui seam): no divergent families; tui_line_scan closed NOT-duplication (render-side scan vs text_buffer line index = layer-separated); tui_tab_expansion recorded gated (production expand_line vs harness oracle expand — independence IS the gate). ALSO MERGED (targeted validation, .mad-only): madcide loud startup failures — profile_dir derives from __FILE__ (any cwd; __FILE__/strrchr/perl::substr all existed — no new intrinsic), load_theme startup failure + parse-handle-0 now post status-line msgs; /tmp absolute-path pty probe green (fn status + colours + no failure msgs; pre-fix: "No profile 'joe'." + monochrome). WAVE 2 (same session): IDE-9a/9b DONE. ONE inverse TOP status row rendered from profile-owned joerc lmsg/rmsg format strings (profiles/joe.status VERBATIM; rmsg[0] = the fill; load_status rides load_profile + a lazy first-compose). Seats: %n %m %R %r/%c (digit width-pads) %o %k %x (the AST-backed enclosing fn - exact where JOE's %x is a textual backward heuristic) %y (the active VIEW name in JOE's '(syntax)' seat; enter_view stamps the view doc's path so %n stays the file) %%; unsupported joerc escapes render EMPTY and light up as features land; \attr escapes consumed (intra-status styling = named seat). Banner + persistent menu GONE (facts moved into the seats); prompts/search/messages OVERLAY the top row ('^C aborts' hint); transient bottom -xmsg startup hint until the first key. %k chord echo is LIVE: NEW public ui::tui_pending + tui_model emits focus (repaint) events on chord open/extend/esc-cancel (tui_pty.py's exact event log updated; chord unit cases extended; a 3-key chord case covers the extension arm). Chrome 3 rows -> 2 (rows 1..22 document, row 23 back on the first key). TWO TRAPS BANKED: (1) RING-LIFETIME - a held .c_str() ROTS across many ring-returning calls (pre-L3 contract): copy into a frame-owned char buffer or pass value& (status_expand does both; the rot handed perl::substr a short string + big offset -> SIGABRT); (2) that abort was a REAL parity defect fixed in its own commit @09897f61: perl::substr past-end offset now yields empty (Perl: undef), reducer tests/testperlsubstrrange.mad against the REAL perl 5 oracle. Dupaudit (status seam): status_priority_rule recorded open (vised + madcide restate prompt>search>msg>idle; not divergent). WAVE 2 BATTERY: fulltest rc=0 + JIT 1157/0/0/9 + EXE 1112/0 (suite 1181 - testperlsubstrrange joined). WAVE 3 (owner-reported regression, same session): madcide startup showed a BLACK screen ~5s. MEASURED on the NAS: tiny .c file paints 0.36s (fixed overhead fine); embed_hello.cpp 3.5s -> the gap IS madc::parse_open (parse-on-load) blocking run_ide's FIRST render, previously masked by fast-failing parses (pre-s134 the deep C++ parse bailed/crashed instantly). FIX @056a9db5: render the document BEFORE ensure_phandle; the loop's first compose repaints with spans + the fn seat when the handle lands (dirty-row delta only). NAS after: first paint 0.38s, highlighted repaint 3.49s. The multi-second NAS parse itself = startup-arc data (installed-C++-header parse on the slow CPU), banked not hidden.

known_pre_existing_gaps: SCRIPT `value` IS NOT YET THE 32-BYTE madc_value STRUCT (recorded 2026-08-17, owner: not to be taken on now). Symptom: `value f()` returned BY VALUE emits `int f()` and silently returns nothing (exit 0, empty output) — func_def's return-type arm -> type_list -> append_type_specs has no dtARRAY case and falls through to int. That is why php::print_r returns madc::value & rather than madc::value. CORRECTED PREMISE: a C type DOES exist — madc_value (include/madc_api.h:52) is a tagged 32-byte aligned(16) struct, and madc::value merely CONTAINS it plus two unique_ptr members (32+8+8 = 48 = the emitted long long[6]); the opaque-buffer lowering exists because of those OWNING C++ members, not a missing type. MEASURED: _array/_object are private with no friends and all 40 refs are in ONE file (src/madc_value.cpp) — 12 mutations, 28 reads; the cell finalizer is already wired and called from generated code (cir_builder.cpp:25789/25797); the is_array_object sites would mostly RETIRE. HARD PART: the class deep-copies the containers while the cell path shares, so the migration needs copy-on-write at those 12 sites — a semantic change with its own oracled tests. Full write-up: docs/plans/2026-06-12-type-table-value-abi-design.md section 9. Sibling defect, also open: assigning to a `value &` PARAMETER is wrongly rejected ('assignment of incompatible value').

VLA sizeof in CONSTANT-required contexts (e.g. `int b[sizeof(vla_a)]`) still folds to 8 via the constant evaluate_type_query path (the expression-path fix doesn't reach it); alignof(vla_var) still reports pointer alignment 8 (gcc: element alignment). Same family, much rarer.

VLA NOT DEALLOCATED ON BACKWARD GOTO: a `goto` jumping back to before a VLA's declaration must deallocate the VLA (gcc/C semantics; gcc-torture 20040811-1.c). madc lowers VLAs as malloc + __attribute__((cleanup)), which frees only on SCOPE EXIT, not on the backward goto re-entering the scope — so a backward-goto loop over a VLA LEAKS one allocation per iteration. 20040811-1.c leaks ~2GB over 1e6 iterations; it passes only when memory is available (it OOM-SIGSEGV'd when the MIR fork's 128MB code-holder reservation reduced headroom — see mir_fork; arch-gated off x86-64, so it passes again). Proper fix: free the VLA at the backward goto. Separate future slice.

MadArray/MadValue namespacing is an open API/ABI follow-up: moving the real C++ types to madc::array and madc::value would give PHP array helpers a normal namespace type surface, but compatibility aliases alone will not preserve old C++ mangled names.

Embedded <iostream> output remains partially staged: cout/cerr/clog still use header-defined stdio-backed ostream bodies. Follow-up is to replace that output surface with real libstdc++ declarations/operators, matching the std::cin direction; do not add stdio.h/FILE* stream bridges.
